commands: RUN_ID="local-$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)-1"; echo "run-id=$RUN_ID"; mkdir -p ".prflow/tmp/review/pr-1636/$RUN_ID"; echo "$RUN_ID" > .prflow/tmp/review/pr-1636/.runid; gh pr diff 1636 | awk '/^diff --git/{in_logs=/ [ab]\/\.prflow\/logs\//} !in_logs' | tee ".prflow/tmp/review/pr-1636/$RUN_ID/diff.patch" | wc -l

mkdir -p .prflow/tmp
rm -f .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-disabled 2>/dev/null
git status --porcelain -z > .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before && [ -f .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before ] && [ ! -L .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before ] && git hash-object .prflow/tmp/review-dirty-tree-before

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
